game.title: Game
game.about: Your Mario Strikers Charged images, the game's language and your saves.

language.title: Game language
language.about: Menus and on-screen text follow the Wii system language.

saves.title: Save data
saves.about: Your progress and trophies, in the game's own Wii save files.

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.about: The game's window and what draws it.

screen.title: Screen
screen.about: How the game opens. The rest of the picture is in the game's OPTIONS > SETTINGS.

window_size.name: Window size
window_size.about: The game window's size when it opens in a window.
window_size.about_remembered: The game window's size the first time; after that it keeps the size you leave it at.

fullscreen_resolution.name: Fullscreen resolution
fullscreen_resolution.about: The screen's resolution in fullscreen. Alt+Enter switches while playing.

display.name: Display
display.about: The screen the game opens on.

antialiasing.name: Antialiasing
antialiasing.about: Smooths jagged edges; the stronger kinds cost more GPU time. Counts from the next start.

renderer.title: Rendering
renderer.about: For a game that does not start or shows glitches.

api.name: Graphics API
api.about: Automatic uses Vulkan, or DirectX 12 when Vulkan cannot start. Used the next time you start the game.

shader_cache.name: Shader cache
shader_cache.about: Clears compiled shaders for all graphics APIs. The next launch prepares them again.
shader_cache.cleared: Shader cache cleared. Graphics will be prepared again on the next launch.
shader_cache.empty: The shader cache is already empty.
